name: AgentDAM
description: AgentDAM is a benchmark designed to evaluate whether autonomous AI web-navigation agents adhere to the privacy principle of data minimization, ensuring they only use sensitive information when necessary to complete tasks. It simulates realistic web interaction scenarios end-to-end and is adaptable to various web navigation agents.
reputation: A recent privacy-focused benchmark from the web-agent literature, but not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on data minimization in AI web agents; evaluates end-to-end realistic web interactions; adaptable to existing web navigation agents.
